name: PostgreSQL
shortDescription: Sonatype Nexus Repository Community Edition backed by a bundled PostgreSQL database, the setup Sonatype recommends over the embedded H2 database.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the generated NEXUS_SECURITY_INITIAL_PASSWORD from the environment; it is applied only on the first start. Finish the onboarding wizard and accept the Community Edition EULA before components can be fetched or uploaded. The first start takes 2-3 minutes.
Community Edition is limited to 40,000 components and 100,000 requests per day, and the JVM reserves about 2.7 GB of heap by default; tune INSTALL4J_ADD_VM_PARAMS to fit your server.
